en: Black-and-white aerial view of a modernist rectangular building surrounded by forested landscape. The structure has a flat roof and large windows on the long side with a covered terrace and steps leading to the entrance. In the distance a large industrial or mining conveyor/structure is visible above the trees. Printed caption text at the bottom left identifies the place as 'Folkets Park "Malmia", Kiruna.' The photographer credit 'Foto: Sven Alm.' appears at the bottom right.
